title: File:C-54 landing on old Tempelhof runway as work continues - USACE-p15141coll5-630.jpeg
desc: Landing of a C-54 'Skymaster' on the old runway at Tempelhof during the Berlin Airlift, while a grade operator levels off the rough spots on the second runway. All heavy equipment had to be cut with an acetylene torch to fit into the aircraft and reassembled in Berlin.
